_Generated 2026-08-10 by /mol:map._

## Inventory (layered)

### Module list

- `src/main.tsx` — browser entry; mounts the application inside `ThemeProvider`.
- `src/App.tsx` — application shell, client-side route selection, page transitions, analytics, homepage composition.
- `src/pages/index.ts` — product-page barrel and `NotFound` re-exports.
- `src/pages/{molpy,molrs,molpack,molnex,molexp,molq,molcfg,mollog}/*Landing.tsx` — code-oriented product landing pages with hero, workflow/toolkit demonstration, API snippets, capability ledger, and product exits.
- `src/pages/molvis/MolvisLanding.tsx` — visualization-oriented product page using the shared hero, capability, and exit language without a code-demo section.
- `src/pages/molrec/MolrecLanding.tsx` — record-contract product page with capability ledger and structured data examples.
- `src/pages/atomiverse/AtomiverseLanding.tsx` — simulation-engine page organized around methods, toolkit/code demonstration, and product exits.
- `src/pages/NotFound.tsx` — branded 404 page with featured route recovery.
- `src/components/{Hero,WhatWeDo,Manifesto,Approach,EcosystemArchitecture,Sponsors,Participate,Newsletter,Cta}.tsx` — homepage narrative sections.
- `src/components/{Navbar,Footer}.tsx` — persistent application navigation and ecosystem/contact exits.
- `src/components/{ProductCapabilities,ProductLinks}.tsx` — shared product-page capability ledger and install/docs/repository exit.
- `src/components/{MoleculeOverlay,FeatureIcons,Icons}.tsx` — molecular imagery, product feature glyphs, and MolCrafts logo presentation.
- `src/components/SEOSchema.tsx` — route-sensitive JSON-LD injection.
- `src/components/{theme-provider,mode-toggle}.tsx` — theme state and user-facing theme selection.
- `src/components/ui/{accordion,avatar,badge,button,card,dropdown-menu,input,navigation-menu,navlink,sheet}.tsx` — generated shadcn/Radix primitives.
- `src/lib/routes.ts` — product slug contract, path parsing, and featured recovery links.
- `src/lib/ecosystem.ts` — categorized product roster and marketing metadata.
- `src/lib/packages.ts` — verified install/repository catalog.
- `src/lib/productAccents.ts` — product color and gradient registry.
- `src/lib/animations.ts` — shared Framer Motion variants.
- `src/lib/{analytics,contact,utils}.ts` — GA page-view adapter, contact-link source, and `cn()` class composition.
- `src/styles/brand-tokens.css` — shared MolCrafts brand anchors, geometry, and shadows.
- `src/styles/tailwind.css` — Tailwind v4 theme mapping, semantic UI tokens, light/dark surfaces, container utility, and shared keyframes.
- `src/index.css` — site-wide typography, decorative backgrounds, gradient text, molecule effects, interaction helpers, and reduced-motion rules.
- `src/App.css` — legacy/decorative loading, molecule, footer, and newsletter styles.
- `src/assets/moko/*`, `src/assets/molecules/*`, `src/assets/{moko.svg,claude.svg}` — branded character, molecular, logo, and sponsor imagery.
- `scripts/og-meta.ts` — build-time per-route title, description, and color catalog.
- `scripts/og-template.tsx` — Satori Open Graph card composition.
- `scripts/generate-og.ts` — font loading plus SVG-to-PNG Open Graph generation.
- `scripts/prerender-html.ts` — canonical/meta rewriting, crawler-readable route content, and static route/404 output.
- `scripts/generate-llms-txt.ts` — agent-readable product/install index generated from application catalogs.
- `scripts/postbuild.ts` — postbuild orchestration for OG, prerendered HTML, and `llms.txt`.
- `rsbuild.config.ts` — React build entry, `@` alias, analytics tag injection, fonts, and default head metadata.
- `package.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `biome.json`, `postcss.config.mjs`, `components.json` — build, typing, formatting, Tailwind/PostCSS, and shadcn contracts.
- `public/{sitemap.xml,robots.txt}` — crawler-visible route registration and indexing policy.

### Public surface

- `src/App.tsx`: default `App`.
- `src/pages/index.ts`: `MolpyLanding`, `MolrsLanding`, `MolpackLanding`, `MolnexLanding`, `MolexpLanding`, `MolqLanding`, `MolcfgLanding`, `MollogLanding`, `MolVisLanding`, `MolrecLanding`, `AtomiverseLanding`, `NotFound`.
- Homepage components: `Hero`, `WhatWeDo`, `Manifesto`, `Approach`, `EcosystemArchitecture`, `Sponsors`, `Participate`, `Newsletter`, `Cta`.
- Shell components: `Navbar`, `Footer`, `SEOSchema`, `LogoIcon`.
- Shared product components: `Capability`, `ProductCapabilities`, `ProductLinks`, `MoleculeOverlay`.
- Feature glyphs: `SimulationIcon`, `AnalysisIcon`, `WorkflowIcon`, `DataIcon`, `CollaborationIcon`, `IntegrationIcon`.
- Theme surface: `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`, `ModeToggle`.
- shadcn surface: `Accordion*`, `Avatar*`, `Badge`/`badgeVariants`, `Button`/`buttonVariants`, `Card*`, `DropdownMenu*`, `Input`, `NavigationMenu*`/`navigationMenuTriggerStyle`, `NavLink`, `Sheet*`.
- `src/lib/routes.ts`: `PRODUCT_SLUGS`, `ProductSlug`, `pathProductSlug()`, `FEATURED_LINKS`.
- `src/lib/ecosystem.ts`: `EcosystemItem`, `EcosystemCategory`, `ecosystemCategories`, `ecosystemItems`.
- `src/lib/packages.ts`: `PackageInstall`, `PACKAGE_INSTALL`.
- `src/lib/productAccents.ts`: `ProductAccent`, `GRADIENT_TEXT`, `PRODUCT_ACCENTS`, `CHIP_ONLY_ACCENTS`.
- `src/lib/animations.ts`: `fadeIn`, `slideUp`, `staggerContainer`, `scaleIn`, `buttonHover`, `sectionTransition`.
- `src/lib/analytics.ts`: `GA_ID`, `trackPageView()`.
- `src/lib/contact.ts`: `CONTACT_EMAIL`, `contactHref()`.
- `src/lib/utils.ts`: `cn()`.
- Build API: `OgRoute`, `routes`, `OgCard()`, `generateOgImages()`, `prerenderHtml()`, `generateLlmsTxt()`.
- CSS contract: `--molcrafts-*` brand anchors; shadcn semantic color/radius tokens; `container`, gradient-text, section-spacing, molecule, focus, and reduced-motion utility classes.
- Operational surface: npm `dev`, `build`, `postbuild`, `lint`, `typecheck`, and `preview` commands; `@/* → src/*` import alias; shadcn `new-york`/CSS-variable configuration.
- Public route surface: `/`, eleven product slugs, `/404`, product docs at `docs.molcrafts.org/<slug>/`, repositories, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, generated `/og/*.png`, and `/llms.txt`.

### Style summary

- `src/App.tsx` and `src/main.tsx`: naming=PascalCase React composition with private uppercase registries; construction=function components and hooks; errors=missing root logs an error, while unknown paths resolve to `NotFound`.
- Product pages: naming=`<Product>Landing`, uppercase local `FEATURES`/`API_SNIPPETS`/`ACCENT`; construction=page-local content composed with shared motion, accent, molecule, capability, and exit modules; errors=render-time state is local and optional catalog values are guarded.
- Homepage sections: naming=single-purpose PascalCase sections with uppercase readonly content arrays; construction=semantic sections, headings, lists, open grids, dividers, and shared motion variants; errors=static presentation with no exceptional control flow.
- Shared product components: naming=domain-oriented `ProductCapabilities` and `ProductLinks`; construction=data-driven semantic `dl`/section layouts; errors=unknown package slugs return `null`, unpublished packages show an explicit note instead of a fabricated command.
- Navigation/theme: naming=PascalCase providers and controls; construction=React state plus shadcn/Radix primitives; errors=route parsing falls back to docs root and theme access throws when used outside its provider.
- Catalog libraries: naming=uppercase immutable registries, singular interfaces, lower-camel query functions; construction=typed arrays/records serving runtime UI and build scripts; errors=nullable values and explicit status/note fields model absence.
- Visual foundations: naming=semantic CSS custom properties plus product-keyed accents; construction=brand anchors → shadcn semantic tokens → Tailwind utilities/component composition; errors=CSS fallbacks are token-driven, with reduced-motion handling in global styles.
- shadcn primitives: naming=Radix-aligned component families; construction=`forwardRef`, `cva`, `asChild`, and `cn()`; errors=delegated to primitive behavior and React typing.
- Motion: naming=shared conceptual variants; construction=Framer Motion variants imported by pages/components, with page-specific interaction state kept local; errors=no exceptional path.
- Static generation: naming=verb-led exported pipeline primitives with private transformation helpers; construction=synchronous filesystem transforms coordinated by async `postbuild`; errors=top-level generators catch failures, report them, and exit nonzero.
- Tooling: naming=ES modules, strict TypeScript, double quotes, semicolons, two-space indentation; construction=Rsbuild + React 18 + Tailwind v4 + Biome; errors=lint/typecheck form the current verification gate.

### Layer roles

- `src/main.tsx`: browser bootstrap layer.
- `src/App.tsx`: application composition and client-routing layer.
- `src/pages/index.ts`, `src/lib/routes.ts`: route/public-page contract layer.
- `src/pages/*`: product-story presentation layer.
- Homepage section components: commercial brand narrative, interactive Applications showcase, and collaboration-conversion presentation layer.
- `Navbar`, `Footer`, `NotFound`: global navigation and recovery layer.
- `ProductCapabilities`, `ProductLinks`: reusable product-story pattern layer.
- `MoleculeOverlay`, `FeatureIcons`, `Icons`, image assets: branded/scientific visual asset layer.
- `SEOSchema`: runtime discoverability metadata layer.
- `theme-provider`, `mode-toggle`: application preference/interaction layer.
- `src/components/ui/*`: generated interaction-primitive layer; consumed by higher presentation layers.
- `ecosystem.ts`, `packages.ts`, `productAccents.ts`, `contact.ts`: shared product/brand content registry layer; consumed by runtime UI and build tooling.
- `analytics.ts`: external telemetry adapter layer.
- `animations.ts`, `utils.ts`: cross-cutting presentation foundation layer.
- `brand-tokens.css`: canonical brand-token foundation shared with the docs theme.
- `tailwind.css`: semantic design-system mapping layer.
- `index.css`, `App.css`: global/decorative presentation layer.
- `og-meta.ts`: static route metadata registry layer.
- `og-template.tsx`, `generate-og.ts`: social-preview rendering layer.
- `prerender-html.ts`, `generate-llms-txt.ts`: static discoverability/content-generation layer.
- `postbuild.ts`: build-pipeline composition layer.
- `rsbuild.config.ts`, `package.json`, TypeScript/Biome/PostCSS/shadcn configs: project tooling and compilation boundary.
- `public/sitemap.xml`, `public/robots.txt`: deployment-facing crawl contract layer.
